g.text: Outliers hidden using 1.5 IQR within each package-method group. Vertical scales differ between packages.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6d7c

g.text: PyPOMP and Cuthbert: 100 initial values per method. Other packages: 6 initial values x 2 replicates. PyPOMP PF likelihood evaluation, J=5,000.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6d7c

g.text: Function names refer to the package above each panel unless another library is named. Added here identifies our code. PFJAX OT differentiation failed; the plotted correction was added here.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6d7c

g.text: Purple methods in PFJAX, PyDPF, TFP and Dynamax: alpha 1, 425 Adam updates without IF2 initialization. PyPOMP / Cuthbert IFAD alpha 1 uses 60 IF2 + 425 Adam updates.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6d7c

g.text: Boxplots and medians use all finite estimates; only points outside Q1 - 1.5 IQR or Q3 + 1.5 IQR are hidden. Bars show +/- 1.96 MCSE. Counts beneath each method give shown/finite estimates.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6d7c

g.text: 69 of 961 finite estimates are hidden; 892 are shown. Nine fits failed, seven without a finite score; all four estimates near -24,868 are hidden. Full results remain in overview_v1.
